newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish shares seen extending slight downtrend.
newsitem.headline: Polish shares seen extending slight downtrend.

text.p: Polish shares were expected to maintain their slight downtrend for the rest of this week during the public offering of copper giant KGHM Polska Miedz SA, which starts bourse trade on July 10.
Analysts said Tuesday's mixed order-balancing session after price-fixing and mixed continuous trade then signalled that any Wednesday fall would probably not be extreme.
They said Bank Handlowy might still have room to rise after Tuesday's 1.6-percent gain in heavy 105.9-million- zloty turnover which followed Monday's debut 8.3 percent above issue.
